text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel chose a male candidate over you, also male. Sex simply isn't a plausible axis of disadvantage here — there's no comparison showing you were treated worse as a man. Raising it would look like grasping, and it would weaken the parts of your case that actually have teeth.

Those parts are real: you appear better qualified on paper (PhD vs. master's, nine years' specialist modelling experience), the stated rationale for the winner is vague — "broad experience of regulatory affairs" — and your request for written reasons has gone unanswered for two weeks.

Chase that request in writing, citing the date. Ask what criteria were weighted and how each candidate scored. Judge the decision on that.
